answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every answer to earn a quorum of attestations only from provably non-kin peers: accounts with no shared funding trail, no recent transfers between them, no common sponsor. A clone farm attesting itself counts for nothing, because its members are kin by construction, while honest peers form wide, unrelated circles whose approval is hard to fake. It works like ferrous ore that only becomes steel after independent forges hammer it, and a cedar grows straight because many winds press on it; a lone clique is nectar the ledger refuses to drink.
